name: Isaac
source: One of the Three Geniuses and the one representing Plan A. Though appears as a cheerful boy who loves the space and the sky, he is extremely ruthless when it comes to pushing his goal into reality. [spoiler]In truth he is AIsaac, an artificial clone with the memory of the real Isaac, a fact that has been driving his existential crisis problem.[/spoiler]
